name: Markets and seafood bowls

cells.what: Tokyo's central wholesale market; fish auctioned and sold on to intermediate wholesalers
cells.who: Inside: trade buyers only, visitors on the gallery and in the restaurant area. Next door: Senkyaku Banrai, open to all
cells.hours: Visitor route 05:00–17:00; closed Sundays, holidays and market holidays. Senkyaku Banrai opens on market holidays
cells.bowl: Served inside and next door; Tokyo says the outer complex cooks with fish chosen by the wholesalers

lineages.name: Ōmichō (Kanazawa) and Hakodate morning market
lineages.nameJa: 近江町市場・函館朝市

cells.what: Ōmichō: a city's kitchen of about 170 shops. Hakodate: about 250 shops, born from farmers selling by the station
cells.who: Anyone; both describe themselves as markets where townspeople buy
cells.hours: Hakodate opens 05:00 (May–Dec) or 06:00 (Jan–Apr) until after 14:00; Ōmichō shop by shop
cells.bowl: Named by count and choice — three toppings you pick, ten kinds, the chef's choice — and some bowls at market price
